subject: DPA / SCCs: execution queue, evidence needed, and order-form sync
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA / SCCs: execution queue, evidence needed, and order-form sync

Hi Claudia / Novamed team,

Quick sync from our side after the legal handoff this morning. We reviewed your latest MSA + Order Form redlines and the separate DPA/SCCs attachment that arrived yesterday. To move to signature this week we need three tidy items from you:

1) Final redline doc (tracked) with specific callouts on the KMS/exceptions language you asked to change — we need line numbers so Legal can tie responses to each row.
2) The processor evidence index (spreadsheet) listing SOC2 scope, subprocessor list, and whether each subprocessor hosts EU data. We attached our suggested template.
3) An explicit statement for hosting jurisdiction: confirm whether you can accept EU-to-US transfer via SCCs + standard addendum, or whether you need a transfer-impact addendum (TIA) with mitigation notes.

Operational asks:
- Karthik: can you pick up redline defense for clause 7.2 (liability waterfall) and 11.4 (export controls)?
- Ben: please confirm whether Dedicated private deployment (VPC) option is in our order-form pricing for this deal (they've redlined that section).

Timeline proposal: if Novamed can send the updated tracked redline + the evidence spreadsheet by EOD CEST tomorrow (Mon 10/05), our legal can do a final pass on Tuesday and we can route DocuSign Wed.

Attachments: redline_summary.pdf (summary of our asks), sccs-evidence-index.xlsx (template)

Thanks — I know this is a tight window but they indicated committed launch in Nov.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Legal Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0192
From: Claudia Reyes <claudia.reyes@novamed.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 18:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: DPA / SCCs: execution queue, evidence needed, and order-form sync

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear list. We can do most of that but two points to highlight from our side before we re-issue the tracked file: 

- KMS / Hosting: our security team is still debating whether we can use a Redwood-managed KMS for EU-hosted workloads. If they say no we'll request an appendix that requires customer-managed keys (we flagged this in clause 9). Will confirm by COB Monday.
- SCCs vs TIA: Legal is leaning toward requiring a transfer-impact addendum because of our regulated dataset classification (category: health-sensitive). They asked for a short call with your privacy lead to walk through mitigations.

We will:
- Upload a tracked redline (v2) with line numbers and comments by EOD Monday (attached to this reply).
- Populate the processor evidence index for the current subprocessor list (first pass) — note: one subprocessor is pending validation.

Question for Redwood: can you confirm whether the Dedicated pricing variant would add a 20% surcharge if we elect private deployment? That affects how we sign the Order Form. Ben / Laura — can you confirm?

Attachments: novamed_redlines_v2.docx (docx), processor_list_firstpass.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Claudia Reyes
Senior Procurement Manager
Novamed
claudia.reyes@novamed.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 20:30:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: DPA / SCCs: execution queue, evidence needed, and order-form sync

Thanks for the ping, Naomi / Claudia. Quick legal notes after scanning novamed_redlines_v2.docx: 

- Clause 7.2 (liability): Novamed inserted a cap carveout tied to data breach remediation costs that is broader than our standard. Proposed approach: keep our cap but add a narrow carveout limited to regulator-ordered remediation and third-party forensic costs (tech ops must approve). I'll draft language and push as a single-line counter in the tracked doc.

- Clause 9 / KMS: if Novamed needs customer-managed keys, that's an operational change (private deploy or bring-your-own-key). We can accept an appendix but need a lead time of 6–8 weeks for onboarding and key exchange verification. Should be disclosed in the Order Form as an implementation milestone.

- SCCs vs TIA: Legal accepts an SCCs route for standard SaaS but for health-sensitive data a TIA is reasonable. Suggest we run a 30-min call Monday with their privacy team. Laura — can you book a slot at 10:00 CEST? I'll prepare a short mitigation checklist: data localization commitment, contractually bound subprocessors list, and technical safeguards (KMS + VPC).

Action items I will take this weekend:
- Draft a short TIA template (1–2 pages) with suggested mitigation bullets.
- Insert our proposed liability carveout language into the tracked redline and upload Monday morning.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: DPA / SCCs: execution queue, evidence needed, and order-form sync

Perfect — thanks everyone. Summary and next steps to keep things tight: 

1) Novamed (Claudia) to send tracked redline v2 + processor evidence first pass by EOD Monday (10/05). Novamed to confirm KMS stance by COB Monday.
2) Laura to schedule 10:00 CEST Monday privacy call (invite sent).
3) Karthik to upload liability carveout counter and TIA template Monday AM.
4) Ben to confirm Dedicated pricing surcharge and whether we can add an implementation milestone to the Order Form.

If we hit all four bullets Monday/Tuesday we'll route DocuSign by Wed and aim for onboarding in November.

Attachments referenced in thread: novamed_redlines_v2.docx, redline_summary.pdf, sccs-evidence-index.xlsx

Thanks — I'll monitor and escalate if anything slips.

Best,
Naomi
